about: Fields of the platform's own metadata JSON that its sync rewrites and its loader never reads, dropped before the file's digest is held to rules/platform-release.lock (that list then holds the digest of the canonical form). Each entry: {"path": <under the home folder>, "fields": [{"key": [<key path>], "type": "iso8601" | "epoch_ms" | "hex_digest"}]}. Empty until a spike (scripts/platform-json-shape.py before and after a platform sync, then a check of the host loader) proves which fields are unused. Batch 5 (d3b, Ken's decision 3, Oct 18).
